content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially in early days of the 30-day horizon; reduce forecasts by 2–5% for early periods.
- Late-period forecasts show upward bias; apply downward correction of 1–3% for days 25–30.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >+5% from prior day), model tends to overshoot; cap forecast increase to +3% from prior day.
- Mean reversion is strong in late cycle; if 30-day average is >90, reduce forecast by 1–2% for next day.
- Model underestimates volatility in mid-cycle; add 0.5–1.5% buffer to forecast if recent 7-day range > 3%.
- Lagged corrections: if true value drops >2% from prior day, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for next day.
